incidents.title: Enrollment API outage causing member registration failures
incidents.rcaSummary: Database connection pool exhaustion due to unoptimized query in enrollment validation service. Connection leak introduced in v8.3.0 patch.

incidents.title: Claims adjudication engine high latency and timeouts
incidents.rcaSummary: Drools rule engine memory leak triggered by malformed claim payload. GC pauses exceeded 30s causing cascading timeouts across downstream services.

incidents.title: Claims engine complete service failure during batch processing
incidents.rcaSummary: Oracle DB tablespace full during nightly batch adjudication run. Auto-extend disabled after last maintenance window.

incidents.title: EDI Transaction Hub processing delays exceeding SLA
incidents.rcaSummary: MQ channel failure between EDI hub and claims engine. Channel auto-reconnect was disabled after security patch.

incidents.title: Member Portal Android app crash on login
incidents.rcaSummary: OAuth token refresh race condition in Kotlin coroutine scope causing null pointer exception on Android 14 devices.

incidents.title: Care Radius Provider Portal intermittent 503 errors
incidents.rcaSummary: Kubernetes pod OOMKilled due to memory leak in Angular SSR rendering. Heap limit exceeded during peak provider search traffic.

incidents.title: Referral Management Engine timeout on large referral batches
incidents.rcaSummary: N+1 query pattern in referral batch processing causing exponential DB load. Missing index on referral_status column.

incidents.title: PBM Claims Processor rejecting valid pharmacy claims
incidents.rcaSummary: Formulary lookup cache stale after overnight refresh failure. NDC code mapping returning incorrect rejection codes.

incidents.title: Prior Authorization System slow response times
incidents.rcaSummary: Redis cache eviction storm due to misconfigured maxmemory-policy. Clinical rules engine falling back to Oracle DB for every request.

incidents.title: Behavioral Health Care Platform session drops during telehealth
incidents.rcaSummary: WebSocket connection timeout misconfiguration in load balancer after infrastructure upgrade. Keep-alive interval set too low for telehealth sessions.

incidents.title: Member Onboarding UI form submission failures
incidents.rcaSummary: CSRF token validation failure after CDN cache configuration change. Form submissions rejected with 403 for users with cached pages.

incidents.title: Claims Intake Service message queue backlog
incidents.rcaSummary: Kafka consumer group rebalancing loop caused by unstable network between AZs. Consumer lag exceeded 500K messages.

incidents.title: Enrollment Engine eligibility check timeout during open enrollment
incidents.rcaSummary: Thread pool exhaustion in eligibility validation microservice. Synchronous HTTP calls to external eligibility vendor blocking all available threads.

incidents.title: Care Radius Provider Portal data sync failure
incidents.rcaSummary: ETL pipeline failure for provider directory sync. Stale provider data served for 6 hours before detection.

incidents.title: Android app elevated error rate after v3.6.0 release
incidents.rcaSummary: GraphQL schema breaking change in v3.6.0 not backward compatible with cached client queries. Rollback to v3.5.4 resolved.

incidents.title: PBM Claims Processor high latency during peak hours
incidents.rcaSummary: Oracle DB query plan regression after statistics refresh. Full table scan on pharmacy_claims table instead of index scan.

incidents.title: Referral Engine duplicate referral creation
incidents.rcaSummary: Idempotency key not enforced on referral creation endpoint. Retry logic in BFF creating duplicate referrals on timeout.

incidents.title: EDI Transaction Hub 837 claim file parsing errors
incidents.rcaSummary: New payer submitted 837P files with non-standard segment terminators. Parser failed silently, dropping claims.

incidents.title: EDI Transaction Hub 835 remittance processing failure
incidents.rcaSummary: 835 remittance file schema version mismatch with updated CMS specifications. Parsing library not updated for 2024 format changes.

incidents.title: Prior Authorization System clinical rules engine error
incidents.rcaSummary: Clinical decision support rules incorrectly denying valid prior auth requests. Rule update deployed without adequate testing.

incidents.title: Behavioral Health platform appointment scheduling errors
incidents.rcaSummary: Timezone conversion bug in appointment scheduling module. Appointments created with incorrect UTC offset for Pacific timezone users.

incidents.title: Member Portal Web elevated P99 latency
incidents.rcaSummary: CDN cache invalidation caused origin server traffic spike. Auto-scaling responded within 15 minutes but P99 elevated during ramp-up.

incidents.title: Corporate Website search functionality degraded
incidents.rcaSummary: Elasticsearch cluster yellow status due to unassigned replica shards after node restart. Search results incomplete for 3 hours.

incidents.title: Provider Directory stale data after sync failure
incidents.rcaSummary: Nightly provider data sync job failed silently. Monitoring alert threshold not configured for sync job completion.

incidents.title: Billing Engine minor calculation discrepancy
incidents.rcaSummary: Rounding error in premium calculation for family plans with mid-month effective dates. Affected 23 accounts with <$0.05 variance.

incidents.title: API Gateway rate limiting false positives
incidents.rcaSummary: Rate limiting counter not resetting properly after Redis cluster failover. Legitimate API requests throttled for 2 hours.

incidents.title: Kafka consumer lag spike on enrollment topic
incidents.rcaSummary: Consumer group rebalancing triggered by deployment of enrollment engine. Partition reassignment caused temporary lag spike.

incidents.title: Data Lake ETL job failure for claims data
incidents.rcaSummary: Schema drift in claims source data broke Delta Lake merge operation. New column added upstream without notification.

incidents.title: Analytics Hub dashboard loading timeout
incidents.rcaSummary: Snowflake warehouse auto-suspend caused cold start delays. Dashboard queries timing out during warehouse resume.

incidents.title: Eligibility Verification Service intermittent failures
incidents.rcaSummary: Circuit breaker tripping on external eligibility vendor API due to increased response times. Threshold too aggressive for vendor SLA.

incidents.title: Dental Benefits Platform claim form rendering issue
incidents.rcaSummary: CSS rendering issue in dental claim form on Safari browsers. Flexbox layout breaking on iOS 17.1 update.

incidents.title: Formulary Management Service cache inconsistency
incidents.rcaSummary: Redis cache replication lag causing inconsistent formulary lookups across pods. Some members seeing outdated drug coverage information.

incidents.title: Telehealth Integration Service video quality degradation
incidents.rcaSummary: Twilio TURN server region failover caused temporary video quality degradation. Fallback to secondary region resolved within 2 hours.

incidents.title: Network Adequacy API response time degradation
incidents.rcaSummary: PostgreSQL vacuum process running during peak hours causing table bloat and slow queries. Autovacuum schedule adjusted.

incidents.title: Member Portal BFF GraphQL query performance regression
incidents.rcaSummary: N+1 query in GraphQL resolver for member claims history. DataLoader not properly batching requests after refactor.

incidents.title: ETL Orchestrator Airflow DAG failure
incidents.rcaSummary: Airflow scheduler memory pressure causing DAG parsing delays. Worker pods not scaling due to HPA metric lag.

incidents.title: RBAC Service permission cache stale after role update
incidents.rcaSummary: gRPC cache invalidation event not propagating to all pods after role permission update. Users retaining old permissions for up to 30 minutes.

incidents.title: Monitoring Stack metric ingestion delay
incidents.rcaSummary: Datadog agent version mismatch after cluster upgrade causing metric submission delays. Agents auto-updated within 2 hours.

incidents.title: Kubernetes Platform node NotReady in us-east-1c
incidents.rcaSummary: EC2 instance hardware failure in us-east-1c AZ. Node auto-replaced by ASG within 15 minutes. Pods rescheduled successfully.

incidents.title: Event Router Service message deduplication failure
incidents.rcaSummary: Bloom filter for message deduplication exceeded capacity. Duplicate events forwarded to downstream consumers for 2 hours.

incidents.title: SAP ERP batch job scheduling conflict
incidents.rcaSummary: Month-end close batch jobs conflicting with daily reconciliation jobs. Job scheduler lock contention causing delays.

incidents.title: Workday HCM integration sync delay
incidents.rcaSummary: Workday EIB integration delayed due to API rate limiting on Workday side during benefits open enrollment period.

incidents.title: Executive Dashboard slow rendering for large datasets
incidents.rcaSummary: D3.js chart rendering performance issue with 10K+ data points. Client-side aggregation added to reduce render payload.

incidents.title: API Developer Portal documentation out of sync
incidents.rcaSummary: OpenAPI spec auto-generation pipeline broken after gateway upgrade. Developer portal showing stale API documentation for 3 days.

incidents.title: Learning Management System video playback buffering
incidents.rcaSummary: S3 bucket region mismatch for video assets. Videos served from us-west-2 to primarily us-east-1 users causing latency.

incidents.title: Procurement Portal search filter not working
incidents.rcaSummary: Django ORM filter query not handling special characters in vendor names. SQL injection protection overly aggressive.

incidents.title: Vision Benefits Portal PDF generation failure
incidents.rcaSummary: PDF generation library memory leak when processing benefit summary documents with embedded images. Library version updated.

incidents.title: Service Mesh Istio sidecar injection failure on new namespace
incidents.rcaSummary: Istio sidecar injection webhook not configured for newly created namespace. Pods deployed without Envoy proxy.

incidents.title: Log Aggregation Service index rotation failure
incidents.rcaSummary: Elasticsearch ILM policy not triggering index rollover. Disk usage approaching threshold before manual intervention.

incidents.title: EOB Generator PDF formatting inconsistency
incidents.rcaSummary: Font rendering issue in EOB PDF for non-English characters. Missing Unicode font mapping in PDF template.

incidents.title: UM Review Portal session timeout too aggressive
incidents.rcaSummary: Session timeout set to 5 minutes instead of 30 minutes after security configuration update. Clinical reviewers losing work in progress.

incidents.title: Identity Provider token refresh latency spike
incidents.rcaSummary: Okta rate limiting during peak morning login window. Token refresh requests queued causing cascading auth delays across all applications.

incidents.title: Member Portal iOS push notification delivery failure
incidents.rcaSummary: APNs certificate expired without renewal alert. Push notifications silently failing for iOS users for 12 hours before detection.

incidents.title: Payment Gateway transaction logging gap
incidents.rcaSummary: Structured logging configuration change dropped transaction audit fields. Payment transactions processed correctly but audit trail incomplete for 6 hours.

incidents.title: Claims engine Drools rule deployment conflict
incidents.rcaSummary: Conflicting Drools rule versions deployed to production. Rule priority ordering caused incorrect claim adjudication for specific plan types. Rollback initiated.

incidents.title: Claims engine database connection pool exhaustion
incidents.rcaSummary: Oracle connection pool leak in claims batch processor. Connections not returned after timeout exceptions. Pool exhausted within 4 hours of batch start.

incidents.title: Enrollment Engine data validation bypass
incidents.rcaSummary: Input validation bypass allowing invalid SSN formats through enrollment API. 47 records created with malformed data before detection.

incidents.title: Care Radius Provider Portal authentication loop
incidents.rcaSummary: SAML assertion clock skew between IdP and SP causing authentication redirect loop. NTP sync issue on provider portal servers.

incidents.title: Kafka platform broker disk space critical
incidents.rcaSummary: Topic retention policy misconfigured for high-volume claims topic. Log segments not being cleaned up. Broker disk at 95% capacity.

incidents.title: Member Portal Web accessibility compliance failure
incidents.rcaSummary: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance audit identified 12 accessibility violations in claims history and benefits pages. Screen reader navigation broken on key workflows.

incidents.title: Data Lake Spark job OOM during large aggregation
incidents.rcaSummary: Spark executor memory insufficient for year-end claims aggregation job. Shuffle spill to disk causing 10x slowdown. Executor memory increased from 8G to 16G.

incidents.title: PBM Claims Processor duplicate claim detection failure
incidents.rcaSummary: Duplicate claim detection hash function collision rate increased after pharmacy network expansion. 156 duplicate claims processed before detection.
